title: Return of deposits / outstanding receipt of money not deposits (Form DPT-3)
subject: ENTITY

periodicity.note: Due 30 June every year for the position as at 31 March, REGARDLESS of when (or whether) the AGM happens. This is the deliberate contrast case with AOC-4/MGT-7: same company, same FY, but this due date does not move if the AGM is delayed.

penalty: Additional fee under s.403; further penalty under s.73/76A for non-compliance with deposit provisions.
